trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide_short: The platinum. It unlocks on its own once the other 54 trophies are on your profile, and every one of them is single-player.
trophies.guide:
The platinum arrives automatically after the other 54 trophies. Treat it as a receipt for the whole list rather than something you chase directly.
1. Work through the other 54 trophies in any order you like; this one has no separate requirement of its own. [S2]
2. Stay in the base game's single-player mode — the set carries no online or DLC trophies, so nothing here depends on other players. [S3]
3. Expect the completion and activity trophies to be the last ones standing: the 100% checklist and the 250-stunt total are the two biggest single asks in the set. [S2]

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide_short: Finish the Chapter 1 mission Gone Fishing. It is one of the first missions in the game, so this one lands almost immediately.
trophies.guide:
Gone Fishing is an early Chapter 1 mission and the trophy is automatic.
1. Play the opening stretch of Chapter 1 until Gone Fishing appears in the mission flow; it sits among the very first missions. [S2]
2. Complete the mission as the story presents it — the official description asks only for the mission to be finished, with no optional objective attached. [S1]
3. Let the mission end normally and the trophy unlocks; because the mission is part of the story path, there is no way to skip past it. [S3]

2. Do not worry if the chapter closes without a trophy: the guide detail says it lands once the first Chapter 2 mission begins. [S3]
3. Keep playing the story path — this is a chapter milestone, so there is nothing optional to complete for it. [S2]

2. Expect the unlock at the transition into Chapter 3 rather than at the exact moment the last Chapter 2 mission finishes. [S3]
3. Nothing extra is needed — the chapter clear is the whole requirement. [S1]

3. Keep the story moving; this one cannot be missed by playing on. [S2]

2. Complete that final mission — nothing in the description asks for a completion percentage. [S1]
3. Keep playing after the credits if you still have cleanup left — free-roam continues once the story ends, so the remaining trophies stay reachable. [S2]

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide_short: Reach 100% on the in-game checklist. This is the biggest trophy in the set and the one most players finish last.
trophies.guide:
The 100% checklist is the long haul. Progress made before the story ends still counts, and nothing on the list can be lost.
1. Open Progress then Stats after the story to see the completion checklist, which becomes visible at that point — earlier progress is already counted. [S2]
2. Clear the items the checklist wants in full: every robbery, bank vault and gang operation, the underwater discoveries, all Shooting Range golds, all drone races and Bret's Target Decks. [S2]
3. Fill the partial quotas as well: 200 vehicle scans, 100 animal studies and 70 of the 80 Challenges. [S3]
4. Work through what is left in free-roam after the credits; nothing on the checklist is missable, so order is your choice. [S2]

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide_short: Land 250 stunts of any kind. The stunt pool is shared across jumps, bridge flights, knife flights and base jumps.
trophies.guide:
Any 250 stunts count. The trophy is a smaller target than the 100% checklist, so it comes along for free on the way to A Long Road.
1. Mix the four stunt types as you like — stunt jumps, flights under bridges, knife flights and base jumps all feed the same total. [S2]
2. Repeat whatever is quickest near you; the trophy asks for 250 stunts and does not require 250 different ones. [S3]
3. Keep going past the trophy if you are also chasing 100%, because that checklist wants 300 stunts in total. [S2]

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide_short: Sample all nine activity types once each. No skill required — you only have to try them.
trophies.guide:
Nine different activity types, one attempt each. Performance does not matter.
1. Tick off fishing, hunting, golf, the shooting range, pool and basketball. [S2]
2. Add the remaining three: an arcade game, a race win and a stunt. [S2]
3. Track the total in the activity list; the counter runs to 9, so one visit to each type finishes it. [S4]

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide_short: Take gold on all 42 Shooting Range challenges, spread over 12 ranges. The set's main skill test.
trophies.guide:
Every Shooting Range challenge needs a gold medal. There are 42 of them across 12 ranges.
1. Find the 12 ranges and clear each challenge at bronze or better first, so every range is open and familiar. [S2]
2. Go back through the challenges and push each one to gold — the counter tracks 42 golds in total. [S4]
3. Leave the ranges until after the story if you prefer; the Shooting Range work is also part of the 100% checklist. [S2]

2. Watch the counter as you go; it runs to 14 locations in total. [S4]
3. Expect to fly more of them later if you are going for 100%, which asks for all 42 drone races. [S2]

trophies.guide_short: Win 20 separate races. Repeating a race you have already won will not move the counter.
trophies.guide:
Twenty distinct race wins. Repeats do not count, so spread your wins around.
1. Pick race events from across the map rather than farming a single favourite — the trophy counts different races. [S2]
2. Win each one; there are 40 races in the game, so you have roughly double the needed pool to choose from. [S2]
3. Check the counter as you go, since a repeat win on an old track will not advance it. [S4]

3. Win that fishing challenge — the trophy tracks the result against Cal, not a weight or species target. [S2]
4. Treat it as a free activity tick as well, because fishing is one of the nine activity types the Master of None trophy wants. [S2]

1. Find a playable arcade title — the source lists four in total, three reachable from the in-game home TV and one on an arcade cabinet. [S2]
2. Play the one you like to its ending rather than chasing a high score; completion is the only condition. [S2]
3. Use the same session to tick the arcade activity off the Master of None list, which asks for one arcade game among its nine types. [S2]

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide_short: Finish eight stranger mission strands anywhere in Leonida. Not every named questline counts toward the eight, and the qualifying list was still being pinned down.
trophies.guide:
Eight stranger strands have to be finished, and the count is pickier than it looks.
1. Take on stranger questlines as they appear around the state; these are the side chains that are separate from the main story. [S2]
2. Finish each strand completely rather than a single mission from it — the counter moves per completed strand. [S2]
3. Do not assume every named character chain qualifies: the source warns that some of them are excluded from the eight. [S2]
4. Expect the exact qualifying set to be the open question here — the source said it was still being confirmed, so treat any list of eight as provisional until it is settled. [S2]
5. Keep going after the story if needed; this work is not part of the 100% checklist and stays available in free-roam. [S3]

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide_short: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida. One early meditation in Chapter 1 is the open question: it may or may not count, so do it and keep a save from that chapter.
trophies.guide:
Eighteen meditation spots, with one early extra that nobody has confirmed either way.
1. Work through the meditation spots around Leonida and sit at each one; the counter runs to 18 in total. [S4]
2. Bring both protagonists to a spot where you can, because meditating with the pair together is reported to count twice toward the total. [S2]
3. In Chapter 1, after the mission Down to Earth, follow Lucia to the balcony at Jason's house and choose Accept when she offers to meditate. That session adds one to the Progress counter but is not flagged as a Meditation Spot, so it is unclear whether the trophy needs it. [S3]
4. Keep a manual save from Chapter 1 before you move on: there is no mission replay and no New Game+, so a missed story-side meditation cannot be recovered later. [S3]
5. Treat the trophy as potentially missable even though the official description says nothing about it — do the balcony meditation on the way past rather than deciding later. [S2]

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.

3. Hunt a unique animal from one of those decks and the trophy should follow, though the source had not confirmed which species is the one that counts. [S2]
4. Keep clearing Target Decks if the trophy has not appeared; the 100% checklist wants all 15 of them anyway. [S2]

trophies.guide_short: Finish any three Collectible Card sets. You do not need the whole collection — three completed sets is the bar.

1. Pick up Collectible Cards as you travel; the sets are the groups those cards belong to. [S2]
2. Complete any three sets rather than spreading cards thin across all of them — the counter stops at 3. [S2]
3. Check the set progress before hunting the last few cards of a set, so you finish three instead of half-finishing six. [S2]

1. Open the WAiNK app on the in-game phone and use it at a location; the counter starts at zero and runs to 100. [S4]
2. Repeat at new places rather than the same one — the trophy counts distinct locations. [S2]
3. Fold the check-ins into other work, since vehicle scanning for Whip It Good runs through the same app. [S2]

sides.claim: Eight qualifying strands are needed, some named questlines do not count, and the full qualifying set was still being confirmed at the source's update date.
Eight strands are required; the trophy is not part of 100% and can be finished in post-story free-roam.

disagreements.call: Our call: ask for eight strands, flag that the qualifying list was still being confirmed, and point players at the in-game counter instead of a guessed list of names.

sides.claim: Hunt a unique animal from Bret's Target Decks, but which animal counts was not confirmed at the source's update date.
Bret's hunting questline starts in Chapter 2 and the 100% checklist needs all 15 Target Decks, so working through the decks is the dependable route.

disagreements.call: Our call: say plainly that the specific animal is unconfirmed, and treat working through Bret's Target Decks as the safe route rather than naming one animal.

disagreements.topic: Ten Pin (#51): description-only inference or a timed bike-kick method?

sides.claim: The description points to knocking people down with a melee drive-by; nothing more specific is confirmed.
A timed method: ten pedestrians taken down with a bike kick inside sixty seconds.

disagreements.call: Our call: label the method inferred from the description and present the timed bike-kick version as an unverified guide claim to re-check in-game.

disagreements.topic: Do the two trackers agree on earn rates?

sides.claim: Just Like Paradise at 99.99% and Paradise Lost at 0.73%, with 4 Platinum Club members.
Just Like Paradise at 93.7% / 97.03% and Paradise Lost at 2.3% / 2.46%, with 0 platinum achievers on the same day.

disagreements.call: Our call: the trackers use different player pools and update at different speeds, so keep every figure labelled with its tracker and never merge them into one percentage. Launch-week numbers are colour, not data.

sides.claim: 54 Xbox achievements against 55 PlayStation trophies.
55 on both platforms, with the platinum equivalent as a 0G 'Mythic' achievement on Xbox.

disagreements.call: Our call: this entry is PS5 only, so the Xbox count stays out of the tracker. The 55 PlayStation trophies are what every other source agrees on.
